contract_limits: Trusted application event source only; dispatch(target_id) is not proof of a real raycast or user gesture
Only existing registered local character.tap and ui.toast are callable; both receive {target_id}, ui.toast wraps local fixed feedback, not arbitrary card JS
Caller owns scene lifecycle and must abort/dispose on invalidation; async handlers must recheck before their own later mutations
No automatic event listeners, scene/joystick/camera changes, microphone, storage or network
Repeated distinct taps may dispatch again after completion; concurrent/reentrant calls are busy, there is no queue
Receipts keep runtime_verified:false; callback confirmation and synthetic DOM feedback are not P0/P1 real-event/device acceptance
